**No.** The latest assessment, run on 12 November 2026, detected **13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2025**, equivalent to 3.91% of the property. The JRC reference classified 98% of that event area as forest in 2020.

The June 2025 assessment only had observations through 2024, so its finding did not cover the newly detected 2025 loss. The annual data do not establish whether the loss occurred before or after the June assessment.

The latest observations extend through 2025; they do not establish whether any further loss occurred in 2026.
